mapping.summary: Requires approval of vendor bank account changes before they can be used in payments.
claims: Vendor bank account changes go through an approval step
Unapproved bank accounts are blocked from payment journals and payment file exports
Approved bank account details are locked against edits
You choose which fields are protected once an account is approved
Required fields on vendor bank accounts are configurable, with conditional criteria
Logs changes made to vendor bank accounts
Documents can be attached to vendor bank accounts
Sends automatic email reminders about bank accounts awaiting approval
Exposes an API that returns bank approval statuses
Any single member of a workflow user group can approve when the group is set up as a team
Annual price per company, with a one month free trial
Trial is unlimited in sandbox environments
Works with Essentials and Premium editions
